bibl.note: The Derveni author as a dualist: the parallel case of Oenopides of Chios. - A further cosmological parallel: the role of air. - The astronomical discovery of Oenopides and the Derveni author. - Oenopides and the Derveni author on the Sun as guardian of the cosmic order. - (Par)etymology and cosmology. - Conclusion.
